This role requires advanced expertise in Microsoft Windows Server environments, VMware virtualization, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops/Remote Desktop Services (RDS), SQL Server administration, and Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI). The incumbent manages enterprise server and network operations, including Check Point firewalls, network switching infrastructure, and Citrix/RDS environments, to ensure high levels of system availability, performance, security, and reliable remote access for end users. The position also participates in a rotating on-call schedule to provide 24/7 support for critical business systems and services. Key Responsibilities Set up, configure, and manage Windows Server environments, primarily focusing on versions 2025 and 2022. Administer and manage Active Directory, including user accounts, permissions, and Group Policy Objects Develop and maintain scripts for automating server tasks, including PowerShell and other scripting languages Install, configure, and manage VMware vSphere environments, including ESXi hosts and vCenter Server. Monitor and optimize the performance of virtual machines (VMs) and physical servers. Configure and manage DNS and web servers to ensure high availability and performance. Implement and manage virtual networks and storage solutions. Perform database administration tasks, including backups, restores, and performance tuning. Perform regular system updates, patches, and backups to ensure data integrity and security. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to server infrastructure, virtualization platforms, operating systems, and storage environments. Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations and procedures. Collaborate with IT teams to design and implement new virtualization solutions. Implement and maintain security measures to protect server infrastructure and ensure compliance with industry standards. Administer and maintain enterprise network and security infrastructure, including Check Point firewalls, VPN technologies, routers, switches, wireless access points, and other network devices. Configure and support network technologies, including VLANs, trunking, link aggregation, port mirroring, TCP/IP, DHCP, and IPSec connectivity. Monitor network and firewall performance, security logs, and alerts; conduct security audits, compliance reviews, and remediation activities as required. Troubleshoot and resolve network, firewall, switching, and connectivity issues to ensure high availability, security, and operational reliability. Participate in disaster recovery planning and testing. Be available for after-hours and on-call support on a rotating basis to ensure the continued availability and reliability of IT infrastructure (typically one week per month) Qualifications, Job Function, Technical Knowledge, And Skills Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in Windows Server administration, including server virtualization, infrastructure management, Citrix / RDS and enterprise network administration. Proficiency in Windows Server 2025 administration. Proven experience as a System Administrator with a focus on server virtualization and VMware. CCNA or equivalent networking certification preferred; Check Point CCSA certification is an asset. Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. review_candidates.description: Application Deadline: 30 November 2026 Department: Projects Location: Louisiana Description The Professional Services Project Engineer delivers ITC's client technology projects across Microsoft 365 and identity, network, server, cloud, and endpoint environments, from scoping and planning through cutover and a quality-controlled handoff to service. Beyond technical execution, this engineer plans the work, runs client calls, documents thoroughly, and drives vendors to resolution. The role handles many small projects at once as well as large multi-site and multi-company programs. This is a hands-on delivery role. The Project Engineer is accountable for completing projects to scope, on schedule, and fully documented, leaving each environment ready for Service to support. Key Responsibilities 1. Microsoft 365 & Identity Implement identity and access management, including Entra ID, MFA, and conditional access. Perform Microsoft 365 tenant setup and migrations. Deploy and configure Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams. Configure Microsoft 365 licensing and security settings. Design, clean up, and consolidate Active Directory environments. Manage Entra Connect sync, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. 2. Cloud, Server & Infrastructure Deploy and manage Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Azure infrastructure. Build and support Hyper-V, VMware, and remote desktop environments. Execute Windows Server builds, upgrades, and migrations. Deploy file and print services. Deploy backup and disaster recovery solutions. Deploy business applications, including CRM, ERP, and line-of-business systems. 3. Network & Endpoint Deployment Deploy and configure firewalls, switches, and wireless. Configure VLANs, VPNs, and ISP circuits. Deliver new-site network buildouts. Execute device deployments and refreshes. Enroll devices through Intune and Autopilot, and manage application rollouts. Conduct site surveys and network assessments. 4. Security & Compliance Roll out MFA, EDR, and backup across client environments. Deliver compliance-driven builds, including GCC, CMMC, and CJIS. 5. Project Execution & Post Go-Live Support Participate in project kickoff meetings to align on scope, timelines, expectations, and risks. Scope projects and prepare estimates. Complete assigned tasks as defined in client Statements of Work (SOWs). Build test, cutover, and rollback plans. Provide post go-live support to stabilize and optimize client environments. Complete a QC'd handoff to service. 6. Project Communication, Documentation & Automation Send weekly client-facing project status updates and participate in check-in meetings. Communicate proactively with clients and internal teams about changes, outages, and project impacts. Collaborate with third-party vendors and co-managed IT teams, and drive issues to resolution. Maintain clear and thorough documentation of systems, configurations, and project processes. Record daily time entries, expenses, and work notes in ConnectWise. Participate in project debriefs and continuous improvement efforts. Use PowerShell and other tools to automate repetitive work. Direct Reports & Organizational Scope The IT Project Engineer is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. Scope includes: Project Range - Many small concurrent projects as well as large multi-site and multi-company programs. Client Engagement - Kickoffs, weekly status updates, check-in meetings, and post go-live support. Vendor Coordination - Working with ISPs, manufacturers, other vendors, and co-managed IT teams to resolve project issues. Service Handoff - Documentation and QC'd transition of completed projects to Service. Role Boundaries The IT Project Engineer owns the technical delivery of assigned client projects, including scoping, estimates, planning, execution, post go-live support, documentation, and handoff to service. This role does not own ongoing day-to-day support of client environments after handoff, which transitions to Service Delivery. This role works closely with Project Management, Service Delivery, clients, and vendors to ensure projects are delivered on scope, on schedule, and ready to support. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise 4+ years in IT infrastructure, including at least 2 years delivering client projects at an MSP or in consulting. Has led Microsoft 365, server, or network projects from start to finish. MSP service-desk experience is a strong plus. Strong written and verbal communication skills with clients and internal teams. Ability to manage multiple projects at once in a fast-paced, client-focused environment. Self-driven and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. Preferred Skills Hands-on depth in Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, or Azure Virtual Desktop. Fortinet, Meraki, or similar firewall, switching, and wireless platforms. PowerShell scripting and automated deployments using IaC (Bicep, Terraform, etc.). Azure infrastructure and migration tools. Backup and disaster recovery platforms such as Datto, Veeam, and Axcient. VoIP and business phone systems. Line-of-business applications such as Sage, QuickBooks, and other SQL-backed applications. ConnectWise or similar PSA platforms. Service-desk experience that has built strong troubleshooting skills. Certifications (Preferred, Not Required) Microsoft: MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), AZ-104 (Azure Administrator). Fortinet: FCP or NSE 4 level. CompTIA Network+. This job description is not an exhaustive list of the duties performed for this position. Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned. Strong experience with VMware ESXi, Proxmox, or comparable enterprise virtualization platforms. Experience designing and supporting Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, and hybrid identity environments. Experience with Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager/SCCM, or another enterprise endpoint-management platform. Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, VPNs, firewalls, and network segmentation. Experience with enterprise backup, recovery, replication, monitoring, patch management, and endpoint-security systems. Experience in planning and leading infrastructure upgrades, migrations, integrations, or system replacements. Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and systems-administration automation. Ability to evaluate technical options, identify risks, and explain recommendations to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to manage infrastructure incidents where decisions may affect production, security, or business continuity. Knowledge of industrial network segmentation, production availability, manufacturing cybersecurity, and secure remote access. Familiarity with MES, ERP, SCADA, HMIs, industrial computers, barcode systems, and other plant technology. Experience designing highly available infrastructure and disaster-recovery solutions. Experience supporting storage systems, clustering, replication, and multi-site environments. VMware, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, or comparable certifications. Design and test backup, restoration, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity procedures. Desirable Experience planning and delivering workload migrations between on-premise and cloud. Experience in financial services or insurance, particularly FCA operational resilience requirements.
